en.title: Hands-free "Hey Grok" on iPhone with Shortcuts
en.summary: iOS reserves wake words for Siri, so there was no hands-free way to open a Grok Bot voice chat.
en.whyItWorks: iOS reserves wake words for Siri, so a Shortcut wrapping Grok Bot's "Start Voice Chat with Bot" action, triggered via Vocal Shortcuts, gets around that. Option B borrows Siri's wake word ("Hey Siri, Grok Bot"), so there is no always-on mic. "Allow Running When Locked" lets it start from the lock screen; one tap is still needed unless Face ID already unlocked it.
workflowSteps: Shortcuts app → + → Add Action → search "Grok Bot" → choose "Start Voice Chat with Bot".
Option A (Vocal Shortcuts): Settings → Accessibility → Vocal Shortcuts → Set Up → pick that shortcut → type "Hey Grok" and say it 3 times.
Option B (follow-up, no always-on mic): rename the shortcut to "Grok Bot" and say "Hey Siri, Grok Bot".
In the shortcut's details, turn on "Allow Running When Locked".
en.promptTemplate: Shortcut action: "Start Voice Chat with Bot" (Grok Bot app) + "Allow Running When Locked". Trigger phrase: "Hey Grok" (Vocal Shortcuts) or "Hey Siri, Grok Bot".
en.connectorsAndRoutines: No connectors. iOS Shortcuts + Vocal Shortcuts or Siri; Grok Bot iOS app. Author notes Option A keeps the mic on (orange dot), drains battery, can clash with calls/recording and false-trigger; Option B avoids that. Locked phone needs one tap unless Face ID already unlocked it.

setupSteps.title: Update the Grok Bot app
setupSteps.detail: No connectors. The shortcut uses iOS Shortcuts plus Vocal Shortcuts or Siri, and the Grok Bot iOS app.

setupSteps.title: Add the action "Start Voice Chat with Bot"
setupSteps.detail: Shortcuts app → + → Add Action → search "Grok Bot" → choose "Start Voice Chat with Bot".

setupSteps.title: Choose a trigger phrase
setupSteps.detail: Option A (Vocal Shortcuts): Settings → Accessibility → Vocal Shortcuts → Set Up → pick that shortcut → type "Hey Grok" and say it 3 times. Option B: rename the shortcut to "Grok Bot" and say "Hey Siri, Grok Bot". Option B does not keep the mic always on.

setupSteps.title: Turn on "Allow Running When Locked"
setupSteps.detail: In the shortcut's details. The shortcut can start from the lock screen, and still needs one tap unless Face ID has already unlocked the phone.

setupSteps.title: Say the phrase and check the voice chat
setupSteps.detail: Saying "Hey Grok" (Vocal Shortcuts) or "Hey Siri, Grok Bot" should open a Grok Bot voice chat. Option A leaves the microphone on (orange dot) and can clash with calls, recording, and false triggers.

acceptanceChecklist: Saying "Hey Grok" (Vocal Shortcuts) or "Hey Siri, Grok Bot" opens a Grok Bot voice chat.
The shortcut that runs uses the Grok Bot app action "Start Voice Chat with Bot".
With "Allow Running When Locked" turned on, the shortcut starts from the lock screen, and still needs one tap unless Face ID has already unlocked the phone.
Vocal Shortcuts (Option A) leaves the microphone on (orange dot); saying "Hey Siri, Grok Bot" (Option B) does not keep the mic always on.

zh.title: iPhone 上免手动唤起 "Hey Grok"（快捷指令）
zh.summary: iOS 的唤醒词只留给 Siri，没法免手动直接打开 Grok Bot 语音对话。
zh.whyItWorks: iOS 的唤醒词只留给 Siri，用快捷指令包住 Grok Bot 的 "Start Voice Chat with Bot"，再经语音快捷指令触发，即可免手动唤起。方案 B 借用 Siri 的唤醒词（"Hey Siri, Grok Bot"），麦克风不用常开。打开 "锁定时允许运行" 后可从锁屏启动；Face ID 尚未解锁时仍需点一下。
workflowSteps: 把 Grok Bot App 更新到最新版。
快捷指令 App → + → 添加操作 → 搜索 "Grok Bot" → 选择 "Start Voice Chat with Bot"（与 Bot 开始语音对话）。
方案 A（语音快捷指令）：设置 → 辅助功能 → 语音快捷指令 → 设置 → 选该快捷指令 → 输入 "Hey Grok" 并念 3 遍。
方案 B（作者后续改进版，无常开麦克风）：把快捷指令改名为 "Grok Bot"，说 "Hey Siri, Grok Bot" 即可。
在快捷指令详情中打开 "锁定时允许运行"。
zh.promptTemplate: 快捷指令动作："Start Voice Chat with Bot"（Grok Bot App）+ 锁定时允许运行。触发语："Hey Grok"（语音快捷指令）或 "Hey Siri, Grok Bot"。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: 无需连接器。iOS 快捷指令 + 语音快捷指令或 Siri；Grok Bot iOS App。作者指出方案 A 麦克风常开（橙点）、耗电、可能与通话/录音冲突并误触发；方案 B 无此问题。锁屏时需点一下，Face ID 已解锁则完全免手动。

setupSteps.title: 把 Grok Bot App 更新到最新版
setupSteps.detail: 无需连接器。用 iOS 快捷指令，加上语音快捷指令或 Siri，以及 Grok Bot iOS App。

setupSteps.title: 添加动作「Start Voice Chat with Bot」
setupSteps.detail: 快捷指令 App → + → 添加操作 → 搜索「Grok Bot」→ 选择「Start Voice Chat with Bot」（与 Bot 开始语音对话）。

setupSteps.title: 选定触发语
setupSteps.detail: 方案 A（语音快捷指令）：设置 → 辅助功能 → 语音快捷指令 → 设置 → 选该快捷指令 → 输入「Hey Grok」并念 3 遍。方案 B：把快捷指令改名为「Grok Bot」，说「Hey Siri, Grok Bot」。方案 B 不会让麦克风一直开着。

setupSteps.title: 打开「锁定时允许运行」
setupSteps.detail: 在快捷指令详情里打开。快捷指令可从锁屏启动；除非 Face ID 已经解锁，否则仍需点一下。

setupSteps.title: 说出触发语，确认语音对话打开
setupSteps.detail: 说出「Hey Grok」（语音快捷指令）或「Hey Siri, Grok Bot」后，应打开 Grok Bot 语音对话。方案 A 会让麦克风保持开启（橙点），并可能与通话、录音冲突，也会误触发。

acceptanceChecklist: 说出「Hey Grok」（语音快捷指令）或「Hey Siri, Grok Bot」后，会打开 Grok Bot 语音对话。
实际运行的快捷指令使用 Grok Bot App 的动作「Start Voice Chat with Bot」。
打开「锁定时允许运行」后，快捷指令可从锁屏启动；除非 Face ID 已经解锁，否则仍需点一下。
方案 A（语音快捷指令）会让麦克风保持开启（橙点）；说「Hey Siri, Grok Bot」的方案 B 不会让麦克风一直开着。
